name: Ars Magna the Division and the Union
desc: You can banish this card from your hand; Special Summon 1 non-Spellcaster "Ars Magna" monster from your GY or banishment, also your "Power Patron" Link Monsters can make up to 3 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn. If a Synchro or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. You can banish 1 "Ars Magna" card from your GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Division and the Union" once per turn.
